## About Luggage and Suitcases For Sale Near You & Online

When you're going on a trip, you need luggage to carry all of your personal items and keep them safe along the way. It's important to pick the right type of luggage for your trip, which means choosing from a duffel bag, a carry-on that fits in the overhead bin, or a set for the family. Sam's carries these styles and more to help you get on your way.

## Frequently Asked Questions: Luggage

### Which brands of luggage are available at Sam's Club, and how do they differ in terms of size, material, and features?

Sam's Club carries luggage brands that include:

- iFly
- Ful
- Member's Mark
- Nautica
- Samsonite
- Brookstone
- it Luggage

Depending on the brand you choose, you'll find that most of the brands feature luggage bags made from soft fabric to hardside spinner suitcases in assorted colors. Each style features multiple compartments, interior straps for security, and handles and spinner wheels for ease of movement. Some pieces come with a TSA-ready pouch, a USB port for keeping your devices charged, interior pockets, and more.

Most luggage pieces range in size from 21" to 32", depending on the type of luggage you select. We offer kids’ luggage sets and backpacks as well, which tend to run smaller than standard luggage and suitcase sizes.

### Do different luggage brands provide variations in design, such as spinner wheels or built-in TSA locks?

It's best to check the designs of each brand to make sure that it has the features or details you're seeking. You can expect to find spinner wheels and a handle on hardside pieces, but they're not as likely to be found on a duffel bag. Features such as TSA-accepted security locks may or may not be included in the piece of luggage you're interested in buying.

Make sure to read the product description before you buy in order to get the best out of your travel experience. Half the battle of travel is buying luggage that meets your needs and more before you depart. You don't want to find out that your luggage is missing a crucial detail at the last minute.

### Are there brand-specific warranties for luggage at Sam's Club?

Each brand has its own specific warranty, which means the warranty is different for each brand. It's a good idea to check the brand's warranty to make sure that you can get coverage for a mishap with your luggage.

Warranties may also vary depending on the type of luggage or travel accessory you purchase. For example, a laptop bag or tote bag will likely not carry the same type of warranty as a full luggage set.

Sam's Club has a 100% satisfaction guarantee policy, which allows you to return an item you're not happy with for a refund. There are exceptions to the guarantee, and some items have a specific policy for handling a warranty. It's worth taking the time to learn more about warranties and guarantees before you buy, as this helps you get the most out of your luggage bag purchase.

### Do luggage brands at Sam's Club come with brand-specific satisfaction guarantees or return policies?

Each luggage brand has its own satisfaction guarantee policy, and all are different from each other. Your best course of action is to check the satisfaction guarantee of the brand before you move forward with buying a particular travel suitcase or bag.
